messages:
amy_ceo: Thanks for the great all-hands today. A few security/privacy follow-ups from the Q&A that we promised we'd surface here. I'll start a list and folks can add corrections.

jordan_security: nice, i'll fill in details. quick note: i'll keep these concise.

amy_ceo: First question: who owns pulling SOC2 evidence for customer audits? engineering asked if they can fetch bundles directly or if compliance will provide them.

jordan_security: compliance will curate the canonical evidence bundles for auditors to ensure scope and redaction. product/eng teams will get read-only exports of artifacts relevant to their services so they can respond to functional questions.

sam_pm: can compliance share a short handoff checklist so teams know what to prepare pre-audit? e.g., infra diagrams, access lists, runbook versions.

nadia_compliance: yes. i'll publish a checklist this week. it will include infra diagrams, IAM access lists, git tags for release evidence, change approvals, key rotation logs, and incident summaries when applicable.

amy_ceo: KMS/BYOQ — customer asked about HSM-backed BYOK with attestation. are we supporting that now?

jordan_security: we currently support BYOK through our KMS integration (wrapped key material). HSM-backed remote attestation is planned: prototype in Q3 and a pilot with a partner in Q4. not GA yet.

maya_infra: to clarify: in Private deployments customers can plug in their KMS endpoints today. HSM driver + attestation workflow is separate infra work and tracked on the private infra board.

ryan_eng: runtime implications: if a customer uses their own KMS, do we call their KMS on every request?

jordan_security: no. we use envelope encryption. runtime fetches/unwraps DEKs at startup/rotation. hot path uses cached DEKs; only rotates/unwraps asynchronously to avoid per-request KMS latency.

sam_pm: audit log exports — teams asked about streaming raw audit logs to customer-owned S3 for e-discovery and retention. what's supported?

jordan_security: streaming to customer S3 and pushing to SIEMs (syslog/Kinesis) is supported for Dedicated and Private. Hosted users will get exported bundles; we're launching a streaming export beta for enterprise next quarter. default retention: 90 days for raw logs, 365 for aggregates; configurable per contract.

ryan_eng: is the audit log schema stable enough for teams to build parsers?

jordan_security: v1 is stable and we aim backward-compatibility for at least one major version. entries include request_id, model, route, token_count, user_id_hash, action, and outcome. examples in the docs.

amy_ceo: ISO27001 timing asked in the Q&A. what's the plan?

nadia_compliance: kickoff next month. we'll map SOC2 controls to ISO controls to reduce duplicate work. target certification ~9 months barring major gaps.

maya_infra: small networking follow-up: for private control planes do we offer AWS PrivateLink endpoints or do customers need VPC peering/VPN?

jordan_security: we support both. options: managed peering for Dedicated, PrivateLink / interface endpoints for Hosted-private connectivity. network diagrams and decision flow will go into the private-deploy handbook.

sam_pm: can we assign owners to these action items so we can track them from the all-hands follow-ups doc?

jordan_security: i'll own SOC2 evidence model and KMS roadmap comms. nadia_compliance will own the auditor checklist and ISO timeline. maya_infra will own network docs and HSM prototype coordination.

sam_pm: i'll create issues and assign owners + due dates, and send a follow-up mail by EOD tomorrow.

ryan_eng: quick ask: can security share a minimal KMS policy example for customer-managed keys so infra teams can template it?

jordan_security: posting minimal example inline now; we'll add to docs: ```json {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE-KEY-ID","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodRuntimeRole"}}] } ```

nadia_compliance: reminder: if teams export logs to customer S3, include a README with retention policy, encryption status, and subpoena/contact info. auditors always ask for chain-of-custody.

amy_ceo: perfect. once the checklist and diagrams are live in #docs, ping me and i'll share in the all-hands follow-up email. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
